## Description

<div class="dcc-reference">

Use `chrome.instanceID` to access the Instance ID service.

</div>

## Permissions

<div class="dcc-reference">

`gcm`\

</div>

## Availability

<div class="dcc-reference">

<div>

<div>

<span class="dcc-tag-pill--blue dcc-tag-pill" title="Available from this Chrome version and higher">Chrome 44+ </span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="dcc-reference">

## Methods

<div>

<div>

<div class="notranslate">

### deleteID()

</div>

<span class="dcc-code-sections__callback dcc-type--xsmall"> </span>

<div>

</div>

``` devsite-click-to-copy
chrome.instanceID.deleteID(): Promise<void>
```

Resets the app instance identifier and revokes all tokens associated with it.

</div>

<div class="dcc-code-sections">

#### Returns

- <div>

  <div class="dcc-type--xsmall">

  Promise\<void\>

  </div>

  </div>

  <div class="pad-top-200">

  <div>

  <span class="dcc-tag-pill--blue dcc-tag-pill" title="Available from this Chrome version and higher">Chrome 96+ </span>

  </div>

  </div>

  Resolves when the deletion completes. The instance identifier was revoked successfully if the promise does not reject.

</div>

<div>

<div class="notranslate">

### deleteToken()

<span class="dcc-code-sections__callback dcc-type--xsmall"> </span>

<div>

</div>

``` devsite-click-to-copy
chrome.instanceID.deleteToken(
  deleteTokenParams: object,
): Promise<void>
```

Revokes a granted token.

<div class="notranslate">

### getCreationTime()

</div>

<span class="dcc-code-sections__callback dcc-type--xsmall"> </span>

<div>

</div>

``` devsite-click-to-copy
chrome.instanceID.getCreationTime(): Promise<number>
```

Retrieves the time when the InstanceID has been generated. The creation time will be returned by the `callback`.

</div>

<div class="dcc-code-sections">

- <div>

  </div>

  </div>

  Resolves when the retrieval completes.

</div>

<div>

<div class="notranslate">

### getID()

</div>

<span class="dcc-code-sections__callback dcc-type--xsmall"> </span>

<div>

</div>

``` devsite-click-to-copy
chrome.instanceID.getID(): Promise<string>
```

Retrieves an identifier for the app instance. The instance ID will be returned by the `callback`. The same ID will be returned as long as the application identity has not been revoked or expired.

</div>

<div class="dcc-code-sections">

#### Returns

- <div>

  <div class="dcc-type--xsmall">

  Promise\<string\>

  </div>

  </div>

  <div class="pad-top-200">

  <div>

  <span class="dcc-tag-pill--blue dcc-tag-pill" title="Available from this Chrome version and higher">Chrome 96+ </span>

  </div>

  </div>

  Resolves when the retrieval completes.

</div>

<div>

<div class="notranslate">

### getToken()

</div>

<span class="dcc-code-sections__callback dcc-type--xsmall"> </span>

<div>

</div>

``` devsite-click-to-copy
chrome.instanceID.getToken(
  getTokenParams: object,
): Promise<string>
```

Return a token that allows the authorized entity to access the service defined by scope.

</div>

<div class="dcc-code-sections">

#### Parameters

- <div>

  <div id="type-getToken-getTokenParams" class="dcc-code-sections__label">

  getTokenParams

  </div>

  <div class="dcc-type--xsmall">

  object

  </div>

  </div>

  Parameters for getToken.

  <div class="dcc-code-sections">

  - <div>

    <div id="property-getToken-getTokenParams-authorizedEntity" class="dcc-code-sections__label">

    authorizedEntity

    </div>

    <div class="dcc-type--xsmall">

    string

    </div>

    </div>

    <div class="pad-top-200">

    <div>

    <span class="dcc-tag-pill--blue dcc-tag-pill" title="Available from this Chrome version and higher">Chrome 46+ </span>

    </div>

    </div>

    Identifies the entity that is authorized to access resources associated with this Instance ID. It can be a project ID from [Google developer console](https://code.google.com/apis/console).

  - <div>

    <div id="property-getToken-getTokenParams-options" class="dcc-code-sections__label">

    options

    </div>

    <div class="dcc-type--xsmall">

    object <span class="dcc-code-sections__optional">optional</span>

    </div>

    </div>

    <div class="pad-top-200">

    <div>

    <span class="dcc-tag-pill--blue dcc-tag-pill" title="Available from this Chrome version and higher">Chrome 46+ </span><span class="dcc-tag-pill--red dcc-tag-pill"> Deprecated since Chrome 89</span>

    </div>

    </div>

    options are deprecated and will be ignored.

    Allows including a small number of string key/value pairs that will be associated with the token and may be used in processing the request.

  - <div>

    <div id="property-getToken-getTokenParams-scope" class="dcc-code-sections__label">

    scope

    </div>

    <div class="dcc-type--xsmall">

    string

    </div>

    </div>

    <div class="pad-top-200">

    <div>

    <span class="dcc-tag-pill--blue dcc-tag-pill" title="Available from this Chrome version and higher">Chrome 46+ </span>

    </div>

    </div>

    Identifies authorized actions that the authorized entity can take. E.g. for sending GCM messages, `GCM` scope should be used.

  </div>

</div>
